response.sql: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT `ANA Pattern`, AVG(`aCL IgG`) as avg_acl_igg FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) as mean_of_averages FROM group_averages), kept_patterns AS (SELECT ga.`ANA Pattern`, ga.avg_acl_igg FROM group_averages ga CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE ga.avg_acl_igg > om.mean_of_averages), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) as mean_of_kept FROM kept_patterns) SELECT kp.`ANA Pattern`, kp.avg_acl_igg, kp.avg_acl_igg - om.mean_of_averages as above_overall_mean, kp.avg_acl_igg - km.mean_of_kept as from_kept_mean FROM kept_patterns kp CROSS JOIN overall_mean om CROSS JOIN kept_mean km ORDER BY kp.`ANA Pattern`
